QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_11

question.text: Haircut on Treasury Bills and liquid G-Sec with residual maturity less than 3 years is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 178, Treasury Bills and liquid Government of India dated securities with residual maturity of less than 3 years attract a 2% haircut. The Trap: The 5% figure applies to liquid GOI dated securities with residual maturity of more than 3 years; other semi-liquid and illiquid GOI dated securities attract a 10% haircut. Note: The haircut rises with longer residual maturity and with lower liquidity of the underlying security.
